§6RBMK Components & Controls

§aEvery column type explained, from fuel channels to the console that saves your reactor.

§6Essential§f:
§b• Fuel Channel§f, holds fuel rods, generates heat and flux
§b• Steam Channel§f, converts water to steam at 4 density levels: Steam/Dense/Super Dense/Ultra Dense
§b• Cover Panel§f, blocks radiation leakage, mandatory on every flux-carrying column

§6Control§f:
§b• Control Rod§f, varies flux 0-100% in 25% steps. Console allows any value.
§b• Automatic Control Rod§f, self-regulates based on temperature. Ignores AZ-5.
§b• RBMK Console§f, 17x17 display, remote rod control, AZ-5 SCRAM button
§b• Crane Console§f, spawns crane for fuel rod removal/placement

§6Moderation & Reflection§f:
§b• Graphite Moderator§f, fast neutrons become slow
§b• Neutron Reflector§f, bounces flux back. Dangerous with linear/quadratic fuels!
§b• Neutron Absorber§f, absorbs all flux, converts to heat (1C per 20 flux)

§6Specialized§f: Irradiation Channel (thorium breeding, Gold-198), Fluid Heater, Cooler (5x5 area, 50 mB/t cold perfluoromethyl), Storage Column (12-item buffer), Structural Column.

§ePS:§f Steam connectors let you hide pipes under the reactor. Worth the extra cost.
